title: JMAP Email/set: wire into dispatcher
description:
Connect the Email/set handler into the JMAP method dispatcher so email creation via JMAP is functional.

Why this issue exists:
Email/set (stoa-f9fd6529) was implemented but never wired into the JMAP dispatcher, so the handler is unreachable. This epic closes that gap.

What needs to be done:
- Wire Email/set into the JMAP method dispatch table
- Verify end-to-end: a JMAP Email/set request creates an article
